name: Tropical leaf-wood TLS
limitations: The source has manual leaf and wood labels. Preserve the source training, validation, and test groups.

name: BCI tropical TLS
attributes: Separate leaf/wood point clouds; repeated QSM fits
limitations: Leaf and wood files can describe the same tree. Several QSM fits can describe one tree. The source has no confirmed paper link.

name: Quebec hardwood MLS
attributes: LAZ; QSM; destructive volume; DBH; field measurements
limitations: Tree IDs connect scans, QSMs, and field attributes. The source names a related manuscript. Its publication DOI is not confirmed.

name: HuashuTrees
attributes: Leaf-on and leaf-off pairs; field attributes
limitations: Two seasonal scans can describe one tree. A sample release can overlap the full release. The article license does not establish the data license.

name: Demol TLS validation
attributes: Clean scan clouds; QSM; destructive biomass/density
limitations: QSMs describe wood reconstructed from scans. Model file counts can differ from biological tree counts.

name: EucFACE
published_count: 116 trees in the study; release population not confirmed
attributes: Individual tree clouds; QSM; analysis code
limitations: The study reports 116 trees. The release population can differ from the study population.

name: Wytham Woods
attributes: PLY scan clouds; optimal QSM; analysis
limitations: The release has 876 trees. The study uses 835 trees. PLY and TXT files can describe the same tree.

name: TreeML-Data
attributes: Point clouds; QSM; graphs; transforms; tree/QSM attributes
limitations: The source covers 40 urban surveys. QSMs and graphs are derived models. Source coordinate transforms are necessary for spatial analysis.

name: BioDiv3DTrees
attributes: Scan clouds; species labels; QSM; graphs
limitations: TLS, ULS, QSMs, and graphs can describe the same trees. Counts from these forms must not be added.

name: FOR-species20K
limitations: This collection includes other sources. Its test species labels are withheld. Component data can have different license terms.

name: Central European TLS trees
attributes: Leaf-on/off scans; measured traits; structural metadata
limitations: Only the measured scan subset is in scope. Procedural foliage and simulated ALS are excluded. Subsets can overlap the full release.

name: SYSSIFOSS
published_count: 12 plots; no unique tree count stated
attributes: Matched scan modalities; traits; acquisition metadata
limitations: The source connects measurements from different platforms. PyTreeDB is a source index. It is not a separate population of trees.

name: TreeScanPL10K
measurement_method: TLS plot clouds with tree IDs
published_count: Paper: 10417 trees; release table: 10447 source-file/treeID keys; 272 plots
species: 30 non-unknown source labels; includes the genus-level Quercus species label
attributes: Plot point clouds: treeID, treeSP, completelyInside. Release table: species, species_code, completely_inside
limitations: The paper and release table have different counts. The reason is unknown. The boundary flag does not measure occlusion.

name: IRLTrees3D
species: mixed trees; source also contains other objects
limitations: Geometry comes from real images. The tree subset needs a source inventory. Images, meshes, and 3DGS are different data forms.

name: Shivalik lidar
limitations: Source data access is restricted. The source pointer can resolve to version 17566270. An open paper does not imply open data.

name: Järvselja shoots
limitations: The measurements describe shoots and needles. These organs are not complete trees.

name: TreeLearn
published_count: 156 manually annotated benchmark trees; 6665 automatically labelled training trees
attributes: Instance segmentation labels; raw plot clouds
limitations: Manual benchmark labels and automatic training labels have different roles. They must be kept separate.

name: DigiForests
published_count: Repeated plots; no unique tree count stated
attributes: Stem and crown labels; tree instances; repeated surveys; field attributes
limitations: Repeated surveys can measure the same trees. The linked project report is not a journal article.

name: TreeScope
limitations: This benchmark describes stems. It does not establish complete crown geometry.
